name: Service Summary
_notes: gridHints picks the metric grid by header text rather than table index, since the
DMS dashboard renders several smaller summary strips before it.
aliases map AutoGroup's 'TOTAL L&P ...' onto DMS's 'SUB-TOTAL L&P ...'. Keys and
values are normalized before matching, which is why they appear expanded here
definitional marks rows where the two products compose the figure differently:
AutoGroup = labour sales + parts sales, DMS additionally includes sublet and nets
discount. Both are internally self-consistent, so these deltas need a product
decision rather than a bug ticket.
ignore drops the section heading rows in the AutoGroup grid.
